title: Momoi Airi — Lots Of Love For My Junior〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Card: Lots Of Love For My Junior（2★）

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, is that about all for our meeting about the stream?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yep!
We're staying here to go straight into practice today, right? I'll do my best!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry.
Can I have a second before that?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: There's something I want to talk to you guys about...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: A hundred things she wants to do...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Wow...!
That's a wonderful notebook that Saki has.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I bet having a notebook like that would make every day more fun since you'd be thinking about which thing to do next!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe, that's true.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And one of the items on her list was “Go to a concert featuring my favorite idol”.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Saki's favorite idol?
In other words...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Did she mean...me?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, I think she did.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (She wrote that list when she was in the hospital, right...?)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Back then, I was mainly doing variety shows and didn't get to appear in many concerts...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (But she still wanted to go to one of my concerts.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, I was wondering if we could do something alongside Airi to let Saki accomplish what she wanted to do...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What do you all think?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: C'mon...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: There's no way I wouldn't be in!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I'd like to join as well. Saki is always looking after Shii, after all.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Me too, me too!
I want to help Saki accomplish what she wanted to do!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Alright, it's decided!
So, let's go ahead and decide what kind of show we should go for!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
The set list, what to do about equipment...
Oh, and we'll need to set the date and time sooner rather than later!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. You're so full of motivation, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Of course I am! Saki's my dear junior and a treasured fan.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Saki's been rooting for you ever since your variety show days, after all.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Right. Even when we first met, the first words out of her mouth were about how she used to watch me on TV, and how it always cheered her up...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (That made me really happy.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Back then... I wasn't able to see the Happy Everyday version of myself as an idol who gave people hope.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Because of what she said, I was able to think of myself as someone who'd managed to deliver hope...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And every time we've met since, she's told me what she thought of our streams and all that, so she's been a great source of encouragement!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
So, now it's my turn!
I wanna make this the best show possible so I can give Saki lots of hope and energy!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah...!
I'll do my absolute best to make sure Saki enjoys it!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then, shall we talk through the details of the show before our practice?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Where should we begin... As well as the time and date, we'll also want to decide the set list soon considering the practice we'll need to do.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh! Then, how about we include an Airi solo?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: If my favorite idol sang a solo just for me... I'm confident I would pass out from the joy!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What kind of confidence is that...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Still, you're right...
If it'll make Saki happy, I want to do it!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'll try to make a list of songs that Saki might like, so I want all of your opinions too!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, of course!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Also, for the location, I'm sure Saki's also busy with her band practices, so I'm thinking it'd be best to do it here at school...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Hehe, seems like things are going to get busy.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I'm gonna do my best to make sure Saki accomplishes what she wanted to do in the best way possible!)
